facts.fact: ZIMSTAT's NSDS III reports that statistical products were produced from administrative records and civil and vital registration during the NSDS II period (2016-2020); no product is named. As_of is the end of that period; the document was published 2024-01-25.
facts.system: Statistical products from administrative records (NSDS II period)

facts.fact: NSDS III states that statistical products of the NSDS II period (2016-2020) were drawn from civil and vital registration, among administrative records; as_of is the end of that period, the document was published 2024-01-25.
facts.system: Statistical products from administrative records (NSDS II period)

note: A strategy, not a statistical product: it names no yearbook, abstract or report, and gives no edition or regular schedule; its plans to strengthen administrative records are intent, not a dated event.
